# go corpus

## Source

Real Go from nine public projects, copied unchanged: Cobra (github.com/spf13/cobra, Apache License 2.0), Gin (github.com/gin-gonic/gin, MIT), Testify (github.com/stretchr/testify, MIT), Zap (github.com/uber-go/zap, MIT), Viper (github.com/spf13/viper, MIT), Logrus (github.com/sirupsen/logrus, MIT), google/uuid (github.com/google/uuid, BSD 3-Clause), the Prometheus Go client (github.com/prometheus/client_golang, Apache License 2.0) and Go's own standard library (go.dev, BSD 3-Clause). Each file is named by its project and its path in the project, `/` written `_`; each project's license is beside it, as `NOTICE-<project>-LICENSE`.

## Version

Cobra at tag `v1.8.1`, Gin at `v1.10.0`, Testify at `v1.9.0`, Zap at `v1.27.0`, Viper at `v1.19.0`, Logrus at `v1.9.3`, google/uuid at `v1.6.0`, client_golang at `v1.20.0` and the standard library of Go 1.26.5; `NOTICE` lists each file with its project.
